names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 ianuarie, «Sfânta Nina, cea întocmai cu Apostolii și luminătoarea Georgiei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Ιανουαρίου, «Αγία Νίνα Ισαπόστολος», with the rank words left off. The page adds a second Greek form of the name in brackets, «ή Νίνω».
Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 14 января ст. ст., «Равноапостольная Нина, просветительница Грузии», with the rank word left off.

birth.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Sfânta Nina s-a născut la sfârșitul secolului al III-lea în Capadocia»; the bounds are that century's last third, and the page gives no year.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «și-a dat duhul în pace în mâinile lui Hristos la 14 ianuarie, cel mai probabil în anul 338» — most probably in 338, which is the only year the page offers for her death.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 января ст. ст. — «Равноап. Нины, просветительницы Грузии (335)»

feast.note: doxologia.ro prints the same line a second time on 19 mai — «Sfânta Nina, cea întocmai cu Apostolii și luminătoarea Georgiei» — but one row is one feast, so the day of her repose is the day recorded here and she is not rendered on the May day.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 14 ianuarie — «Sfânta Nina, cea întocmai cu Apostolii și luminătoarea Georgiei»

attestations.note: The Romanian calendar keeps her twice: 14 ianuarie, the day of her falling asleep, which is the row held here, and 19 mai, where doxologia.ro repeats the same line (read 20 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Ιανουαρίου — «Αγία Νίνα Ισαπόστολος»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Slujitoare a cuvântului dumnezeiesc, cea întocmai cu Apostolii, Nina, lui Andrei cel întâi chemat şi altor apostoli în apostolească propovăduire te-ai asemănat, luminătoarea Iviriei şi alăută a Duhului Sfânt, roagă-L pe Hristos Dumnezeu să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

english.text: Handmaid of the divine word, equal to the apostles, Nina, thou wast made like to Andrew the First-called and to the other apostles in apostolic preaching, enlightener of Iberia and harp of the Holy Spirit: pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Слова Божия служительнице,/ во апостольстей проповеди первозванному Андрею/ и прочим апостолом подражавшая,/ просветительнице Иверии и Духа Святаго цевнице,/ святая равноапостольная Нино,/ моли Христа Бога// спастися душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 января ст. ст., «Тропарь равноапостольной Нины», глас 4

english.text: O handmaid of the Word of God, who in the apostles' preaching didst imitate Andrew the First-called and the rest of the apostles, enlightener of Iberia and harp of the Holy Spirit, holy Nina equal to the apostles: pray to Christ God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Приидите днесь вси,/ воспоим избранную от Христа/ равноапостольную проповедницу Божия слова,/ мудрую благовестницу,/ люди Карталинии приведшу на путь живота и истины,/ Богоматере ученицу,/ усердную заступницу и неусыпающую хранительницу нашу,// Нину прехвальную.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 января ст. ст., «Кондак равноапостольной Нины», глас 2

english.text: Come all ye today, and let us hymn her whom Christ chose, the preacher of God's word equal to the apostles, the wise bringer of good tidings, who led the people of Kartli into the way of life and of truth, the disciple of the Mother of God, our fervent intercessor and unsleeping guardian, the all-praised Nina.
